prose: Dave Maybee, the Wizard of Ears, joins InnerVerse for an educational trip through the fractal mysteries represented on the human ear. As director of the Canadian Institute of Auricular Medicine, Dave combines a variety of modalities with the energetic blueprint of the ear. Tune in to learn about Auricular history, the ear as a diagnostic window to internal functions, the ear's correspondence points and DIY ways to work with them.
ext: We discuss the convergence of Dave's work with psychology, innovative methods for trauma resolution, the true nature of memory, the ear as a map of our fetal body, and lasers (for health!).
music: "Universe In Your Eyes" by Wisdom Traders
